<cfif a>
    <cfset y = 1 // runs past > to the end
    >
    <cfset z = 2 // self-closed
    />
    <cfset w = a + b // at the end of a binary
    >
    <cfif x // a condition
    >
        q
    </cfif>
    <cfquery name="q">
        SELECT a FROM t
        <cfif x // in an island
        >WHERE b = 1</cfif>
    </cfquery>
</cfif>
<cfset s = {a: 1, b: [1, 2]} // before the value
>
<cfreturn new Foo(a, b) // before the name
>
<cfset x = foo(a ? b : c, [1, 2]) // inside the arguments
>
